doc_kind: medical policy (Florida Blue Medical Coverage Guideline, site-of-service review)
lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions (disclaimer p.1)
Federal Employee Program (FEP): follow FEP guidelines
State Account Organization (SAO): follow SAO guidelines
Medicare Advantage: reviewed NCD/LCD listed in Program Exceptions

Comparative-effectiveness section 'only applies to member contracts that contain a comparative effectiveness analysis within the definition of Medical Necessity ... issued or renewed on or after January 1, 2014'
effective_or_revised: Original Effective Date 10/01/25; Reviewed 07/24/25; no Revised line (17 pages)
sections_in_order: Header block (policy number, Original Effective Date, Reviewed, Revised)
criteria_location: Position Statement pp.3-5: a ~25-item any-of list of patient conditions justifying hospital outpatient setting, a second any-of list of ASC-inaccessibility reasons, and a Comparative Effectiveness Analysis prose algorithm. Definitions section supplies thresholds (HbA1c, BP, arrhythmia). The procedures covered are the ~230-line CPT list in Billing/Coding.
procedures_covered: ~200+ CPT codes of select surgical procedures (11770 through 69660) when performed in an outpatient department of a hospital

logic.top_level: any (patient conditions) OR any (ASC access barriers); then a separate cost-comparison step that can still deny
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Complement rule: 'do not meet the definition of medical necessity when the criteria above are not met.' Plus comparative effectiveness can override a met criteria set.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: meet the definition of medically necessity for a member with any of the following conditions: (not an all-inclusive list)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Declared non-exhaustive: other conditions might qualify, so a closed any-of tree is wrong.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: If a service meets the medical necessity criteria set forth above ... an analysis under this comparative effectiveness section should be applied
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Meeting the criteria is necessary but not sufficient when the contract has comparative effectiveness language.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: For Medicare Advantage Members, procedure not on Medicare's ASC list of covered procedures.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A line-of-business conditional inside an any-of list.

requirement_kinds.quote: No geographically accessible ASC has the necessary equipment for the procedure
No geographically accessible ASC is available where the member's physician has privileges

thresholds.quote: systolic blood pressure ≥ 140 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure ≥ 90 mmHg

time_windows.quote: History of transient ischemic attack (TIA) < 3 months
drug eluting stent placed within 1-year, bare metal stents or plain angioplasty within 90 days
History of myocardial infarction, event < 3 months

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: The code list defines the scope (which procedures get reviewed) rather than supporting a diagnosis; no ICD-10.

external_dependencies.what: Member contract wording on comparative effectiveness
external_dependencies.quote: For member contracts that include comparative effectiveness language, the relative cost ... may be considered
Claims Processing Manual. Chapter 14 - Ambulatory Surgical Centers

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: fasting blood glucose ≥ 180 mg/dL; Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) ≥ 9%; or postprandial blood glucose ≥ 250 mg/dL.
systolic blood pressure ≥ 140 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure ≥ 90 mmHg, despite treatment
Examples of significant cardiac arrhythmias include ventricular fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia, atrial fibrillation

vague_terms.quote: Developmental stage or cognitive status necessitating use of outpatient department of a hospital
Advance surgical planning determines overnight recovery and care ... is necessary
Moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA)

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip
Position statement embeds a literature 'Analysis' with numbered findings after the rules; rules and evidence summary run together
CPT list occupies lines ~285-527 with wrapped descriptors; code range spans many specialties
Original Effective Date (10/01/25) is later than Reviewed (07/24/25) and there is no Revised line
Comparative Effectiveness paragraph is one 16-line sentence block
interesting_structures: Site-of-service rather than service medical necessity: the question is where, not whether
Two-stage logic: criteria first, then cost comparison that can still deny
Line-of-business branch inside criteria (Medicare ASC list)
Definitions provide numeric thresholds for conditions named in criteria

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Condition list is a clean any-of, but non-exhaustive wording, cost-based comparative step, contract-dependent applicability and ASC availability facts that are not in a clinical chart require constructs beyond all/any/not.
